info.title: OCLR Read API
info.description: Stage 2 (#269). Public projections remain public-only even with a token. Explicit invalid Authorization never falls back to anonymous/cookies. Reads never fetch providers or mutate business data. Later collection pages require version and restart on 409.

get.description: Current token identity and effective read scopes; browser cookies are never used.
